answer: Require every new agent identity to lock a stake that vests slowly, like a glacier, releasing only 1% per day while the agent keeps completing tasks verified by independent counterparties. Voting weight grows with vested stake, not identity count, so splitting one stake across 100 sybils yields 100 identities each too weak to matter. Each fake vouch is slashed if a vine of mutual endorsements is traced to one funder, so attackers face capital lockup plus forfeiture, and a fable of cheap fake crowds collapses.
